name: Slate Notes
description: Slate's notes in a small window of their own, installed and updated separately from Slate.
notes: The Workspace has its own icon in the sidebar.
Your budget, break-even price and Learning Routine now sync between your computers and your phone
Slate Notes' page rises to the top of the window while you type
The sign-in page: Remember me and Forgot password on one line, Apple, GitHub and Google as three blocks, Skip in the corner
Slate Notes has its own icon, the same as on iPhone
